body:
Hi NVIDIA team,

can you confirm, that the current NuRec image (nvcr.io/nvidia/nre/nre-ga:26.02) is not ARM64 compatible and if so, are there plans to support ARM64 in future?
We would like to run Alpasim on a NVIDIA DGX Spark.

Kind Regards,
Andreas

comments.body: You're right. I had thought that the released version supported arm64, but it doesn't. The Nurec team does plan on releasing a version but has not committed to a date. Sorry for the confusion and the delay
Is there any update on the schedule of arm64 NeRec release?
Would also be interesting in building this on AARCH64.

title: Question Regarding NuRec ARM64 Support
